title: A New Scroll and Judgment Against Jehoiakim
description: After King Jehoiakim burned the first scroll, the Lord commanded Jeremiah to take a new scroll and write down the same words again. God pronounced a harsh judgment against Jehoiakim: none of his descendants would sit on David's throne, and his body would be thrown out to lie in heat and frost. Jeremiah dictated anew for the scribe Baruch, and many similar words were added. [ref:Jer 36:27-32|Jeremiah 36:27-32]
